title: CR-BRK-002 — No Reports + everything else ON — login dependency
preconds: Reports \u2717 | WO V/E \u2713 | Customers V \u2713 | Schedule V \u2713 | See Financial \u2713 | View Mode: Full (View Mode as specified).
steps:
1. Configure a custom role per the Setup in Preconditions; assign to a test user and log in.
  2. Log in; observe landing page; refresh; navigate.
expected:
User logs in normally and lands on an accessible page. Reports OFF only hides the Reports nav (§2a OFF = nav hidden). No Access-Restricted screen on login/landing/refresh.

Risk / Rationale: Reports OFF acts as an unintended login/landing dependency → Access Restricted on login/refresh (known defect family).
Spec Ref: §2a Reports
